desc: Daniel Defense led the way with 3D-printed suppressors with the DD Wave. Now they expand that innovation further. Meet the Mute30Ti. Designed for shooters who want complete noise reduction without sacrifice. Its weldless, fully 3D-printed titanium construction offers strength, consistency, and precision - weighing only 8.3 ounces. Engineered to minimize flash signature, keeping your shots cleaner and your position more secure. With HUB compatibility, the Mute30Ti easily fits into your current setup. The Mute30Ti. Embrace the sound of silence. Top of Form
